description: A rage-fueled warrior bonded with the parasitic fungi of Sproutrest, trading sanity for overwhelming symbiotic power. Purple mycelia pulse through their veins like living armor.
icon_hint: spiked fist wreathed in purple mushroom caps and toxic green spores
card_prompt: Pixel art, SNES style. A decorative card frame background for a fantasy fungal berserker rage warrior class. Jagged torn mushroom-cap border with toxic green dripping pustules at corners. Dark purple-black organic mass center with pulsing toxic green veins and purple mushroom growths. Spiked fungal fist silhouette at bottom. Color palette: dark purple, toxic neon green, organic brown. No characters, no text.
